bell_witness.caveat: Fixed measurement settings, no space-like separation, fair sampling assumed: this witnesses entangling-gate and readout fidelity on the device that produced the randomness. It is not device-independent certification.

commitment.note: Formed at submit, after the provider accepted the job and before any outcome existed. Publish `commit` before collect completes for it to mean anything to a third party.

device_fingerprint.note: ⟨Z⟩ on randomness qubits should be ≈0 (readout/prep bias shows as a nonzero value); witness qubits are expected to be biased by their rotated bases. ZZ pairs between randomness qubits should be ≈0 — nonzero values are crosstalk / correlated readout and lower the entropy budget.
